name: Sweet Melissa
source:
Louise's mum has sent her to stay in the country to "get away from it all." Join her for her first day in the sleepy village of Hindcross as she tries to get her bearings with help from her Auntie Elizabeth.

[From [url=https://glaistigs-garden.itch.io/sweet-melissa]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
路易丝的妈妈让她留在乡下“远离这一切”。与她一起度过在沉睡的欣德克罗斯村庄的第一天，她试图在伊丽莎白阿姨的帮助下找到自己的方位。

[来自[url=https://glaistigs-garden.itch.io/sweet-melissa]itch.io[/url]]
